Routine preoperative voided urine culture was negative, but intraoperative pelvic urine culture grows Ureaplasma urealyticum. During PCNL stone fragmentation, high renal pelvic irrigation pressure (> 35 mmHg) is recorded, and the patient suddenly develops severe hypotension, shivering, and septic shock. Which of the following pathophysiological mechanisms best explains this sudden intraoperative urosepsis?

Anaphylaxis to contrast medium administered during retrograde pyelography.

Acute adrenal crisis precipitated by operative mechanical stress.
